title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1556: Assembled invincible (3)

section.p: “Amazing!” Su Yu laughed as he looked at the four Invincibles. Suddenly, his eyes widened as he exclaimed, “Holy shit! Why are you here as well?”

This time, the four Invincibles didn’t even bother to react. He had used the same trick multiple times before. And they had fallen for it thrice. Fuck him! No expert would be able to approach them completely undetected.
Why was he still using this trick against them?
Suddenly, a laugh rang out behind them, “You are always so naughty. Why is everything a joke to you?”

Then, a sword shot forth and stabbed through an immortal king who had lost a body to Su Yu previously. Instantly, that body was destroyed. The third body emerged, but it was grabbed and crushed by Wan Tiansheng’s palm immediately.
More crimson clouds appeared in the sky and a rain of blood started falling.

Walking leisurely atop a River of Time, Wan Tiansheng smiled and said, “Your physical strength is quite impressive, but it’s a pity. You are so talented in the power of laws. How did you become a barbarian?”
He had killed an Invincible like an ant.
Su Yu laughed heartily and said, “Amazing, Principal. Where have you been hiding previously?”
“Fortunately, you sent Lan Tian back with some useful treasures. I am almost fully recovered.”
Wan Tiansheng was busy healing his wounds earlier or he would have appeared much earlier. The way he had appeared felt almost legendary. He had easily squashed an Invincible to death.

Sure, that was an injured Invincible who had lost a body, but he had still died without even knowing that Wan Tiansheng had arrived. The three Invincibles were horrified to see how strong Wan Tiansheng was.

Wan Tiansheng said, “Let’s finish the job. Since you’re good at brute strength, I’ll stop their Rivers of Time. It’s rare for us to work together. I have thought that this wouldn’t happen anytime soon.”

Yes. Wan Tiansheng was good at the manipulation of laws. An incredibly thick River of Time washed over and wrapped around the Rivers of Time of the three Invincibles. With a roar by Wan Tiansheng, the Heart Cultivating Pavilion emerged, transformed into a sword, and shot forth. The world itself paled at the brilliance of that sword.

Su Yu had long known that Wan Tiansheng was good at the manipulation of laws. After all, Wan Tiansheng had taken him on a trip through time and space to meet Grandstar previously. He was a terrifying expert, but he was rather lacking in pure offensive strength.

Thus, his combat strength would be comparable to a fourth or fifth degree Eternal. In a true fight to the death, he might not be able to kill such an Invincible. But right now, there was no need for him to perform the kill himself. He only needed to keep the spacetime manipulation of the Invincibles in check.
Su Yu’s eyes lit up in excitement.
Holy shit!
The principal sure was helpful! With that, he would no longer need to open the death tunnel.

As Wan Tiansheng kept the three Invincibles busy alone, Su Yu opened his Heaven Gate. Then, a gigantic book appeared, covering even the sky from view. He was not going to allow even one of them to escape. He would kill them all. Without their Rivers of Time, some mere middle-degree Eternals were nothing for him.

Su Yu took in a large amount of death qi, activated his pass character, and appeared before an Invincible with a flicker. That Invincible was already used to moving through the River of Time. Thus, he was finding his movements awkward now that Wan Tiansheng was keeping his River of Time tangled.
A punch from Su Yu arrived.
The Invincible was blasted apart. At that, Wan Tiansheng shifted the River of Time slightly. When the Invincible returned, he was greeted with yet another punch by Su Yu.
“No…”
A miserable wail reverberated in the air.
More crimson clouds appeared in the sky. At the same time, multiple golden clouds appeared and descended upon Su Yu. He had finally accumulated enough kills for more heavenly rewards.

He took all the blood, flesh, and golden clouds into his Mark of Civilization. He was too busy to focus on the rewards. There were two more Invincibles to deal with. The fight felt a lot more comfortable with Principal Wan’s assistance.

Wan Tiansheng and Su Yu were both smiling gently, one in fluttering white robes and one in fluttering black robes. Su Yu and his excessive physical prowess and Wan Tiansheng with his ability to contain the Rivers of Time of their opponents. This was a fatal combination.
“A little bit more, Principal. I’ll kill him next!”
Su Yu pointed at one of the two Invincibles. Noticing that, the Invincible roared in panic and detonated his body before igniting his blood essence and vanishing into the distance.
He fled.
Yes. He fled.
He was too scared to continue the fight.

He did not fear fighting Su Yu alone since it was very difficult for Su Yu to land a hit on him. He also didn’t fear fighting Wan Tiansheng as Wan Tiansheng would be too busy handling his River of Time instead of doing anything else. But the combination of Wan Tiansheng and Su Yu…was a hopeless fight for him.

The other Invincible, a devil king, attempted to do the same and flee as well. However, his body was cut apart by Wan Tiansheng before he could self-detonate. Then, Su Yu’s punch arrived as he roared, “The fuck are you running for?”
Were Invincibles so useless? Only two were dead. One had escaped, but this devil king was an Invincible as well, right? Why was he running away? Just stay and fight!
The punch blasted the body apart. Wan Tiansheng manipulated the River of Time, hastening the return of the devil king. Instantly, the devil king returned only to be met with Su Yu’s fist.

And finally, the devil king was dead. Everything had happened in mere moments. In fact, Wan Tiansheng hadn’t even arrived for five seconds and three of the Invincibles were already dead, with one fleeing after sacrificing a body. That attracted the gaze of numerous experts. Everyone had different expressions.
Wan Tiansheng. Su Yu.
When working together…they were horrifying.
The battle had just started yet four Invincibles had died. Great Qin King had killed one while Wan Tiansheng and Su Yu had killed three. Invincibles were falling like rain.
At that point, some of the minor race Invincibles had arrived. There were about ten of them so far. They all had solemn expressions.
They had just arrived. They had witnessed how Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng had killed three Invincibles in the blink of an eye. They were terrified.
It was only natural for them to feel fear.

Someone sighed and said, “With Wan Tiansheng controlling time and space and Su Yu attacking the bodies, anyone who is not a late-degree Eternal will merely be throwing their life away attacking them.”
The two weren’t Invincibles. Yet an ancient expert had declared that nobody below the late-degree Eternal Realm stood a chance against them. Their combination was simply a perfect match.
Su Yu had the offensive strength of a late-degree Eternal while Wan Tiansheng had the control of a late-degree Eternal toward time and space. Together, they were akin to a late-degree Eternal.
Ignoring the Invincibles around them, Su Yu looked at Wan Tiansheng and sighed, “Principal, your River of Time is getting even thicker than before. How did you accomplish this? Can you teach me?”
He still seemed as cheerful as ever, as though he was completely unbothered by the difficult battle ahead of him.
Wan Tiansheng laughed and said, “What’s the rush? This isn’t something you can do quickly. How can I be your principal without being capable enough myself?”
Su Yu laughed again. Old Wan was indeed impressive.

Without Old Wan, it would have taken Su Yu a lot more time to kill the three Invincibles. He also had to fight a lot more carefully to prevent them from turning the situation around. But with Wan Tiansheng around, the fight became much simpler and enjoyable.

Yes. Enjoyable. After all, missing his attacks all the time was greatly annoying. That would no longer be an issue. With Old Wan around, he no longer feared the Invincibles’ control over the laws. He no longer needed to take the beating of the Invincibles helplessly.
The change attracted numerous gazes.
Immortal Realm.

Tiangu had an unsightly expression. He had not seen this combination coming. The four Invincibles had been defeated just as the reinforcements arrived. Tiangu turned and looked inside the Immortal Realm with a deep frown. They had deployed a lot of immortal kings for this.
If they were to deploy more…he looked in Eastrift Valley’s direction. There, numerous human experts were waiting. If more immortal kings were deployed, the humans would definitely attack.

What was the point of killing Su Yu if they couldn’t even protect their home? Tiangu forced himself to calm down and looked in the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion’s direction. That man must have seen and sensed the same as well. Would he be able to keep ignoring Su Yu?
Heavenly Hunt Pavilion.
The Heavenly Overseer Marquis was deep in thought. He felt as though he was looking at Culture King. He saw Culture King’s shadow in both Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng.
They were all so similar.
It was as though Culture King had been reborn.
When the two smiled, it felt as though Culture King was smiling at him. That smile. That chilling smile.
He shut his eyes. After a while, he opened his eyes and ordered, “Kill Su Yu.”
The pavilion Invincibles were surprised to hear that. Were they really joining the battle? Was the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion not staying neutral anymore?
